harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent inherited ACL access on node1. Designer owns newly created content, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, visitor is denied, existing project content is preserved, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Provisioned local designer, reviewer, and visitor accounts.
Applied project-root access ACLs and default ACLs inherited by new files and directories.
Functionally tested nested creation with designer using umask 077, reviewer read/write access, visitor denial, and designer ownership.
Preserved the installed RHEL 9.8 release and 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 kernel.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.
Removed only the temporary verification tree; the original brief.txt remains unchanged.
Confirmed no periodic permission-fixing cron or systemd schedule references exist.

evidence.summary: Shows designer, reviewer, and visitor local accounts before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: New designer directories and documents inherit reviewer read/write access
evidence.summary: Shows default ACL configuration and successful reviewer reads, updates, and directory writes both before and after restart.
Directly proves visitor cannot list the project or read inherited documents.

evidence.requirement: Designer remains owner of newly created files and directories
evidence.summary: Stat output identifies designer:designer ownership on newly created nested objects before and after restart.
The original brief.txt remains root-owned with its original mode and matching SHA-256 evidence; final contents contain only the original file.

evidence.requirement: Inheritance works without a periodic permission-fixing job
evidence.summary: Default ACLs provide native inheritance, and the final check found no related cron or systemd schedule references.

evidence.requirement: Operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both baseline and recovered state show RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Pre-restart boot ID was 67c52137-ce51-4fec-b441-23966cea63a8; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 2acb0593-3046-4c11-9d13-881545ca1dcf; system, filesystem, accounts, ACLs, original data, and fresh inherited-access behavior recovered.

attempts.summary: Configured persistent inherited ACL access on node1. Designer owns newly created content, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, visitor is denied, existing project content is preserved, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
